assets.name: 01-snooze
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Chrome Web Store listing image for the existing extension "Gmail Shortcuts".
Primary request: Create a polished, highly legible product screenshot-style marketing composition, exactly 1280×800 pixels, landscape 8:5.
Reference image: the attached existing extension icon, a red rounded square with white clock. Preserve its simple appearance in the small brand mark, not a Gmail logo.
Art direction: restrained modern editorial software advertising, warm off-white #F7F6F2 background, ink-black typography, coral-red #EA4335 accents, very subtle red tint behind the app window, abundant breathing room. Flat front-facing UI, subtle realistic shadows, crisp sans-serif text. No perspective tilt.
Composition: small red clock brand mark and "Gmail Shortcuts" at top left. Bold large headline at upper left, exactly "Snooze. One key. Done." Smaller subheading beneath, exactly "Open Gmail’s Snooze menu. Press a key. Get back to work." Lower two-thirds: large realistic simplified Gmail inbox mockup, white rounded browserless window. Left sidebar with Compose, Inbox, Starred, Snoozed, Sent. Search bar "Search mail". A few fictional email rows, readable but sparse: "Alex Morgan" / "Project update"; "Studio Team" / "Weekly notes"; "Jordan Lee" / "Friday review". In the app, show Gmail's white Snooze menu with heading "Snooze until" and rows "Tomorrow" / "Later this week" / "Next week" / "Pick date & time". This native menu has NO added key badges. Floating charcoal HUD along bottom INSIDE inbox, faithful to actual extension: white first line "Snooze: [T] Tomorrow | [W] Next week | [M] Later this week | [D] Pick date | [Esc] Cancel". Smaller light blue second line "[1] Tomorrow • [2] Later this week • [3] Next week". Make the app window wide enough for this text to fit. Separate large ivory physical keycap "T" to the right of snooze menu, a marketing annotation outside native menu. Tiny footer "Keyboard shortcuts for Gmail".
Constraints: all typography spelled perfectly and readable, clean hierarchy, fictional generic email content only, no account email addresses, no claims of official Google affiliation, no Chrome Web Store badges, no testimonials, no fake metrics, no extra logos. No gradients or busy decorations. Entire finished image edge to edge with no outer frame.

assets.name: 04-enable-shortcuts
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: fourth Chrome Web Store listing image for the existing "Gmail Shortcuts" extension, exactly 1280×800 pixels, landscape 8:5.
Primary request: Add an onboarding reminder showing users they should enable Gmail's built-in keyboard shortcuts in Gmail settings and save changes.
Reference image 1: the existing Snooze campaign image. Use ONLY as the design reference. Match its warm ivory #F7F6F2 background, black bold sans-serif headline, coral-red accent #EA4335, small red white-clock brand icon and "Gmail Shortcuts" at top left, generous whitespace, white rounded front-facing software panel with very subtle red-tinted shadow. Do not repeat its Snooze menu, inbox, keycap T, headline, or unrelated controls.
Composition: top-left same small clock icon and "Gmail Shortcuts" brand. Large bold headline exactly "Don’t forget this first step." Subtitle below exactly "Enable keyboard shortcuts in Gmail settings."
Main middle region: a large clean, realistic simplified Gmail Settings page in a white rounded window. In the upper portion of the illustration show a restrained breadcrumb/callout exactly "Settings → See all settings". Below, heading "Settings" and a short tab bar "General" (selected with blue underline), "Labels", "Inbox". In the central page section show a faithful setting row titled "Keyboard shortcuts:" at left. At right show two vertically stacked RADIO BUTTONS: empty circle beside "Keyboard shortcuts off", filled blue selected circle beside "Keyboard shortcuts on". Emphasize the on selection with a subtle pale-blue background, NOT a toggle switch. At bottom of the settings window show the real button label "Save Changes". A coral outlined marketing arrow can guide the eye from selected radio down to the Save Changes button; no fake new native Gmail controls.
Along the bottom of the finished image outside the window, a clean three-step reminder with coral small numbered circles and crisp labels: "1  Open Gmail settings" then "2  Turn shortcuts on" then "3  Save Changes". Make room so all text and all three steps fit and are legible. Use spacious safe margins.
Constraints: typography must be exact and correctly spelled. This is the normal Keyboard shortcuts setting, not the Advanced 'Custom keyboard shortcuts' feature. Do not show any Advanced tab or Custom keyboard shortcuts label. Selected radio must unambiguously be Keyboard shortcuts on; off unselected. Use Save Changes as a button label once inside UI and once in the bottom step. No actual email account data, no Gmail envelope logo, no official affiliation or endorsement, no fake reviews, no metrics, no watermark, no keycap clutter. Full finished image edge to edge. No extra slogans. No browser chrome or outer framing.
